route: Work permit (general or temporary) under the Labour (Relations) Act, R.S.A. c. L7, Part 11

permit.applies: The prospective employer applies; the Labour Commissioner processes it and the Minister grants it; the fee is paid solely by the employer
permit.first: Advertising for at least 2 consecutive weeks in a media outlet the Commissioner approves, for an Anguillian, an Anguillian's spouse or a qualified resident (the Minister may waive it where the skill isn't available)

fees.what: Non-refundable application processing fee, every work permit application (Work Permit Regulations 2023 reg. 8(3)); the grant fee is set by occupation in Schedule 1, which lists no performer, so the Minister sets it (reg. 2(3)), pro rata for a temporary permit (reg. 10(3))

permit.eligibility: "All work permit holders shall be subjected to— (a) conditions of good character; (b) the person demonstrating a positive contribution towards the development of the Anguillian society" (Work Permit Regulations 2023 reg. 4).

sources.title: Labour (Relations) Act, R.S.A. c. L7 (revised 31/12/2022), Part 11 Work Permits, ss. 164-178 (Government of Anguilla)
sources.said: (d) vary, renew or extend a work permit. … 165. (1) There are 3 categories of work permits— (a) a general work permit; (b) a temporary work permit; and (c) a self-employment work permit. … (a) processing all applications for work permits; … A person who seeks to be self-employed or a prospective employer may apply for a work permit in the manner prescribed. … that the prospective employer has sought by advertising for at least 2 consecutive weeks in a media outlet approved by the Commissioner to ascertain the availability of any one or more of the following in the order in which they are listed— … the Minister may grant a work permit for a term that the Minister considers necessary, but any term shall not exceed one year. … The Minister shall specify in the prescribed manner the fee and security deposit to be paid solely by the employer for every application for grant, renewal or extension of a work permit under this Part.

note: Work Permit Regulations 2023: a skilled or professional permit runs up to 2 years (reg. 3(b)); a temporary permit for a specified task that starts and finishes within 4 months runs up to 4 months, extendable by up to 2 months, no further after 6 months (reg. 6). The regulations write the fee as "$300"; Anguilla's currency is the Eastern Caribbean dollar.
